node.chars: Data: synthetic only — a seeded BTCUSDT book (seed 503): tick 0.10 and qty step 0.001 from the recorded instrument fixture; mark 64,560.2 at t0; 500 levels a side; sizes, walls, stops, the own orders and the viewing-as user "Manager 01" are synthetic; cost and clamp figures are a kit model, illustrative, PROPOSED, not a budget. No real account identifier, key or balance. The env badge reads the session environment (DEMO here), never the feed (C-2.11).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §10 L317 SCR-051/unsaved-esc: signal Esc with unsaved changes; shows W-29 in the footer; a second Esc discards; keyboard focus stays where it was; announced W-29 polite once (R-5); T2 none

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Trail length changed 60 → 120 s (a visual key), then Esc: W-29 in the footer, once through the status node; a second Esc discards; focus stays where it was (C-3: no nested modal)

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Tab order (§13.1): 1 close → 2 tablist (one stop) → 3 Depth tier → 4 W-15 → 5 Row aggregation → 6 Columns → 7 Trail length → 8 Decay → 9 Reset to defaults → 10 Reset this tab → 11 Cancel → 12 Save; the tile and the cost panel are not stops; the focus trap holds

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: §13.1 L388: ← / → in tablist: previous / next tab, activated (automatic)

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: §13.1 L389: Home / End in tablist: first / last tab, activated

kids.name: value-6
kids.chars: §13.1 L390: ↑ / ↓ / ← / → in a radio group: moves within the group; lands on a T2 option without selecting it (R-3)

kids.name: value-7
kids.chars: §13.1 L391: Space in checkbox, radio: toggles or selects; on a T2 option re-shows W-3 (R-3)

kids.name: value-8
kids.chars: §13.1 L392: Enter in a text field: commits and validates the field; never Saves

kids.name: value-9
kids.chars: §13.1 L393: Enter / Space in a button: activates it; on gated Save re-shows the notice (§8.4)

kids.name: value-10
kids.chars: §13.1 L394: Esc in an open list: closes the CMP-009 list only; the dialog stays

kids.name: value-11
kids.chars: §13.1 L395: Esc in dialog: no unsaved changes: cancels; unsaved: W-29 once, a second `Esc` discards (C-3)

kids.name: value-12
kids.chars: §13.1 + the Enter row (§3.2, G-T2.3): Enter on a T2 option (the 500 radio) re-shows W-3, as Space does; it never selects the option

kids.name: value-13
kids.chars: W-37 (the foot strip's right marker): either reset writes it once through the status node (R-5, §13.2) and keeps focus on its button; Cancel undoes it (§2.1); not this frame's state, drawn here so every R-5 announcement has a board

value-1.chars: 200 % in the 1280 × 800 frame: the dialog fills the viewport (CMP-043 reflow); the tablist wraps to two rows; the body scrolls between the fixed header and the sticky footer, so Save, Cancel and the status node stay visible; the tile moves under the fields at full width (below this scroll position)

value-2.chars: The focused field is never under the footer (`05`:99); at 400 % (320 CSS px) the footer wraps to two rows and every field is one column — not drawn, the text is binding (§13.3)

value-3.chars: §13.4 forced colours: preview tile ramp — the canvas keeps its ramp (a data image); the tile's name and the fields carry values

value-4.chars: §13.4 forced colours: palette options — CMP-006 radios in system colours; each option's name carries its set and convention in words

value-5.chars: §13.4 forced colours: legend (CMP-113) — its words and anchors in `CanvasText`; the ramp bar keeps its colours (`forced-color-adjust: none`)

value-6.chars: §13.4 forced colours: gradient bar — the bar keeps its ramp; each stop handle outlined in `ButtonText`, focused `Highlight`
